subject: dxf: add common prefix to global sort object path and change the rule on when to add cluster-id as part of the path (#66179)
summary: Changes global-sort cloud storage URI derivation to always add a `dxf/` prefix and to append PD cluster ID only when SEM is disabled and the configured URI has a non-empty path prefix; introduces `storeapi.Prefix.ToPath()` to normalize URL paths and updates affected DDL/import tests.
